Also note: the dossier's healthcare concerns are resident-facing (waiting times, youth care) — not traveler exposure much. Legal representation gap is situational but relevant for recourse.

I'd put it around 0.45–0.50. The documented exposure is custody placement — bad but conditional. Social climate on the island unclear; one anecdote suggests friction not hostility. No documented police targeting, no border friction, no facility ban.

I'll go 0.45.
